t: You're on Grosvenor Place, a street in Belgravia that runs from Hyde Park Corner down the west side of the Buckingham Palace gardens. It joins Lower Grosvenor Place, where there are some cafes and restaurants, and meets Grosvenor Gardens to the south, which leads to Victoria station. At number 17 is the Embassy of the Republic of Ireland. Thomas Agar-Robartes, the sixth Viscount Clifden, was born here in 1844. He was a landowner and Liberal politician.
